review_scope: Every exact source text, English text including internal footnote anchors, footnote content, confidence, validation, transcription_uncertainties and additional_translation_input control across all eight rows. Accept means supportable bounded selected printed edition treatment; not manuscript/original reconstruction or human expert certification.

reviews.rationale: The exact selected transcription preserves both visible main-text stars and drops only raised apparatus numerals. On PDF68 the first-person opening, storehouses/blessing/heaven, descent-to-earth, and work/toil of human offspring are present. The English does not import rain, fertility, reward, or another witness. Humankind is a defensible inclusive equivalent for children of men, while work and toil remain distinct. Notes identify the plural object and actual critical signs without substituting variants. Medium confidence and pending-review status are appropriately bounded.

The photo has peace, rectitude, shared/companion relation, all days of eternity, and all generations of eternity. The precise candidate preserves these relations and the final age/eternity wording rather than the facing-witness alternative. Uprightness and companions are within the personally photographed lexicon ranges. There is no Ethiopic main-text star at the opening: the raised 48 is an apparatus reference. The source and note correctly avoid transferring the Greek star.

The complete unit starts at XII on PDF68 and runs on PDF70 to the numeral2. The hidden/cover reading has direct photographic lexical support at Dillmann849, including its XII.1 reference; it must not become taken up merely because the facing Greek has that reading. The English retains the negative human knowledge and three questions: where hidden, where he was, what happened. Matters for the introductory words/matters is bounded and introduces no new event. Source span and note match the selected edition.

Bounded acceptance of a deliberately difficult printed-edition unit, not source-issue-free certification. Actual PDF70 has star plus daggered all-word, a further star at Watchers, work with Watchers, and compressed holy-ones/his-days wording. The exact source retains those signs; the note explicitly names corruption and rejects silent replacement by the editor's proposed article repair. English distributes the two compressed complements intelligibly without inventing another event. Low confidence is appropriate; an empty transcription-uncertainties array here means no unknown glyph placeholder, not that the critical reading is intrinsically secure.

The exact source and English follow the printed Ethiopic: I Enoch was blessing the Lord of majesty and King of eternity; Watchers called to me, Enoch the scribe, and said to me. The internal star and actual apparatus8/9 editorial emendations are disclosed rather than advertised as unchanged manuscript wording. The photo has ኮንኩ, not an independently printed standing predicate; the English correctly avoids adding stood. Scribe is supported by the actual Dillmann1268 entry. Note and medium confidence appropriately limit the claim.

Do not apply this whole row. The exact source still contains two present-day uncertified-glyph placeholders, in the imperative after ሑር and before ሉደ. The relevant photographic crops were personally viewed, but I am not certifying either glyph from the expected sentence. Therefore the provisional make-this-known and human-children English cannot pass exact source/English acceptance. The source validation, low confidence, structured uncertainties, and note correctly acknowledge this. Readable surrounding details and the final corruption clause do not remove the hold; no Greek repair or grammatical normalization is authorized.

The selected printed unit is negative third-person plural, peace plus forgiveness of sin. They will have neither peace nor forgiveness of sins preserves the negative scope and person, unlike substituting a second-person address from the facing witness. The final sin noun is visibly present and the note correctly preserves it despite the reported omission. Source has no uncertified glyph or missing sign identified here.

Bounded acceptance of the selected causal opening, not a reconstruction from the facing text. PDF70 begins with conjunction plus እስመ and ends with a negative for them mercy and peace, with a real star immediately before mercy. The candidate retains because, the children/beloved distinction, seeing loved ones killed, crying over children's loss and pleading forever; it does not imply a granted plea. Actual lexical photographs support joy/delight, beloved, loss/destruction lead, crying and petition, and mercy. The English contrast but does not reverse the negative. Source, notes, medium confidence and no-added-input control are consistent with the bounded claim.
